Its route is distinct from the nearby +12 V and +5 V strips. This supplies photographic GND identity for D42.7 and D43.7; the owner has not meter-confirmed it.

It continues left through D58.20 to registered D26.26, whose broad spur is independently traced to the terminal engraved +5 V; the screw-area continuity is recorded in d26-d58-plus5-strip-review.json. The owner photo supports +5 V via D26.26, without a meter reading.
solder_photo_review.component_pin14_check: In component image 200452717, the lower-right package contacts near (1970,2410) for D42.14 and (2500,2410) for D43.14 have no visible front-copper departures outside their solder fillets; the same is true in the alternate 200443117 close-up. solder_photo_review.disposition: Treat owner D42.7/D43.7-to-GND and D42.14/D43.14-to-+5 V as photo-supported strip paths. Optional power-off continuity checks provide independent electrical confirmation; the routed replica still requires a pin-aware copper reroute and DRC review.
